lanes.name: unit
lanes.description: In-process pytest over tests/unit and tests/contract. Contract tests use FastAPI TestClient (httpx, already a transitive dep) against the real router tree, so they stay in-process and need no port.

lanes.name: e2e
lanes.description: Playwright via pytest-playwright against a live reader3-server. Needs a live_server fixture in tests/e2e/conftest.py — not written yet, so no setupCommand is configured.

lanes.name: packaging
lanes.description: Builds a wheel, installs it into a clean venv with dependencies resolved at LATEST (uv.lock deliberately not used), starts a real reader3-server and hits four routes. The only place in the repo that would notice a dependency major bump breaking the installed app -- uv run and the unit lane both go through the pinned lock and stay green. ~17s, so it gates on push, not on commit.
